step1_analysis.circuit_type: Stacked LNA and Mixer with Current Bleeding
step1_analysis.description: A low-power RF front-end sub-circuit combining a cascode Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) and a switching mixer in a stacked configuration to share DC current. A current bleeder transistor (XM3) is used to independently optimize the DC current through the LNA (which needs higher current for gain/noise) and the mixer (which needs lower current for higher load resistance and conversion gain).

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the stacked LNA and mixer branch

sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 17.5 mW for the entire receiver. This single stacked branch consumes much less, determined by the LNA bias current.

conversion_gain.description: Voltage conversion gain from 2.4 GHz RF to 800 MHz IF

sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 41 dB for the full receiver chain. This single stage provides around 10 dB depending on the IF load resistor.

lna_dc_current.description: DC current through the LNA transconductor

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the provided W/L=10 and a reasonable overdrive voltage for saturation.

noise_figure.description: Noise figure of the receiver front-end

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominated by LNA transconductor noise. NF ~ 1 + gamma/alpha + ...
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be similar to the paper's reported value, though highly dependent on exact sizing and matching. (Requires PNOISE analysis).

step3_testbench.description: Measures DC power, branch currents, and transient Conversion Gain using an 800 MHz LC tank to extract the IF signal.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Stacked LNA and Mixer Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/libs.tech/ngspice/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

XM3 N2 N3 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 VLO N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM1 N7 VIN N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM5 N5 N2 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM2 N1 VB1 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

* Connections (Stacking LNA output N1 to Mixer source N2)
Vshort N1 N2 0
Vn6 N6 0 0
Vn0 N0 0 0
Vn5 N5 VDD 0

* IF Load (LC Tank tuned to 800 MHz to filter out RF/LO)
Ltank N4 VDD 10n
Ctank N4 VDD 3.958p
Rtank N4 VDD 5k

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVB1 VB1 0 1.2
VVB2 N3 0 0.68

* RF Input (2.4 GHz, 10mV amplitude)
VVIN VIN 0 DC 0.8 SIN(0.8 0.01 2.4G 0 0)

* LO Input (1.6 GHz, 300mV amplitude)
VVLO VLO 0 DC 1.5 SIN(1.5 0.3 1.6G 0 0)

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
let id_lna = -i(Vn6)
let id_bleeder = -i(Vn0)
print power id_lna id_bleeder

* Transient Analysis for Conversion Gain
tran 10p 25n
* Measure peak-to-peak of IF output after settling
meas tran vout_max max v(N4) from=15n to=25n
meas tran vout_min min v(N4) from=15n to=25n
let vout_pp = vout_max - vout_min
* Input amplitude is 10mV, so input peak-to-peak is 20mV
let cg_linear = vout_pp / 0.02
let cg_db = 20 * log10(cg_linear)
print cg_db
quit
.endc
